blocks.text: A reflection arrives late and continues a gesture after the pet stops.
Location: The River of Deferred Reflections
Appearance: Godot draws three translucent copies of the current pet frame in different directions. Reduced motion holds them still.
Care: Calm care, rest, and stress medicine.
Story connection: A river artist could ask whose delayed gesture is still waiting to be seen.
New gameplay lore; future hook is hypothetical. Location status remains: Proposed.
